title: Response Outcome
description: A platform-neutral record of what actually occurred after a bounded response decision was submitted for execution. The outcome preserves requested-versus-executed response, capability limitations, fallback behavior, execution status, side effects, and provenance without asserting that the underlying structural condition was resolved.

outcome_id.description: Unique identifier for this response outcome.

decision_ref.description: Reference to the tf.containment-decision object that requested or authorized the response.

pattern_ref.description: Optional direct reference to the structural pattern associated with the originating decision.

executed_response.description: Response actually executed by the platform or adapter. Null means no response action was executed.

effects.description: Directly observed execution effects. These describe consequences of the response operation, not verification of the underlying structural condition.

side_effects.description: Observed or reported secondary effects associated with execution.

errors.description: Errors encountered while attempting the response.

warnings.description: Non-fatal conditions or limitations relevant to interpretation of the outcome.

verification_required.description: Whether a subsequent verification pass is required. Successful execution must not by itself be interpreted as proof that the underlying condition was resolved.

verification_ref.description: Optional reference to the tf.verification object produced after this outcome.

extensions.description: Domain-specific or platform-specific execution data. Extensions must not redefine canonical outcome semantics or convert execution success into an implicit resolution claim.

action.description: Response operation requested or executed. Domain-specific controlled vocabularies may be used.

target_ref.description: Reference to the actor, resource, scope, or structural target of the response.

status.description: Execution state of the requested response. This field describes action execution, not resolution of the underlying structural condition.

attempted.description: Whether execution of a response was actually attempted.

started_at.description: Optional time at which execution began.

completed_at.description: Optional time at which the execution attempt ended.

executor_ref.description: Reference to the adapter, system component, human operator, or execution mechanism responsible for the attempt.

authorization_ref.description: Optional reference to the authorization under which execution occurred.

reason.description: Optional bounded explanation of the execution status.

used.description: Whether the executed response differed from the requested response because a fallback path was used.

reason.description: Reason a fallback response was selected.

requested_action.description: Original requested action when useful for explicit comparison.

degradation.description: Relationship between the requested response and the fallback response.

capabilities_ref.description: Reference to the tf.platform-capabilities declaration applicable at execution time.

required_capabilities.description: Capabilities required by the requested response.

available_capabilities.description: Relevant capabilities actually available to the executing adapter.

unavailable_capabilities.description: Required or relevant capabilities unavailable at execution time.

type.description: Category of directly observed execution effect.

state.description: Evidence state associated with the effect.

target_ref.description: Optional reference to the affected actor, resource, session, environment, or context.

description.description: Optional bounded description of the effect.

source.description: Optional component or adapter reporting the condition.

retryable.description: Whether another execution attempt may be appropriate. Null indicates that retryability is unknown.

available.description: Whether a rollback path is available after execution. Null indicates that availability is unknown.

rollback_ref.description: Optional reference to the rollback procedure, recovery object, snapshot, or resulting rollback record.

status.description: Execution state of rollback when applicable.

producer.description: Adapter, execution system, human operator, orchestration component, or other producer responsible for recording this outcome.

created_at.description: Time at which this outcome record was created.

platform.description: Optional platform or execution environment in which the response was attempted.

adapter.description: Optional adapter responsible for executing or reporting the response.

adapter_version.description: Optional version of the executing or reporting adapter.

source_refs.description: References to execution logs, platform responses, decision objects, or other lineage objects supporting this outcome.
